purpose: Eight source-locked attacks and weapon actions; all frames downloaded and visually reviewed after completion.

jobs.review: Red detached pixel/impact artifacts appear around the hook during the swing; gameplay effects must not be baked into the sprite.
The cleaver is redrawn into an unrelated thin blue weapon in the contact frames; weapon identity is not source-safe.
A large white impact burst is introduced over the torso; impact effects belong in Unity, not in the character animation.
Bright green magical blobs, glow, and detached particles are generated throughout the attack.
All 9 frames reviewed. The body, head, club, chain, palette, transparency, and planted silhouette remain intact; a readable club raise, contact pose, and return are present without gameplay effects.
Bright green glow, trails, and a detached horizontal energy bar are added to the club action.
The candle attack contains generated fire arcs and projectile-like flame bursts; only body motion and the contact pose are allowed.
Blue/yellow magical trails, particle pixels, and an altered face appear across the intermediate frames.
